header.title: China's state-backed financing structure sustains long-cycle industrial capex despite delayed returns

s01_bottom_line.text: The article argues China's financing system — bank lending, government support and capital markets — can fund the Industry 5.0 transformation even when commercial returns take years.
The article presents this funding structure as supporting the sustained investment needed to advance Industry 5.0.
This funding durability is what the article presents as the enabler that de-risks the multi-year capex thesis, though it may also perpetuate overcapacity.

items.text: China's financing system — bank lending, government support and capital markets — is positioned to fund long-cycle industrial transformation even when commercial returns take years.
